title: Cover and Border
author: Beatrix Vasquez
blurb: Hazel Sterling, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
